task_description: Fix styling bugs in the Naming Nosferatu app: broken Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes (unregistered stardust color, missing blob animation, missing duration-fast token), z-index stacking conflicts (modal vs navbar), and overflow issues (TournamentComplete w-screen).
